endpoints.label: MAVLink
endpoints.hint: QGroundControl: Application Settings → Comm Links → Add → Type UDP → Server: this host and port. Mission Planner: pick UDPCl and enter it.
endpoints.appHint: Aircast QGroundControl sets itself up from the button below — cameras and telemetry in one tap.

schemes.label: UDP · listen
schemes.hint: The device listens here and any ground station on the network can connect. This is the usual choice.

schemes.label: UDP · send to
schemes.hint: The device pushes telemetry to this address. Use it when the ground station cannot reach the device first.

schemes.label: UDP · broadcast
schemes.hint: Telemetry goes to every host on this subnet — one link, several ground stations.

schemes.label: TCP · listen
schemes.hint: The device listens for a TCP connection. Slower to recover on a lossy link than UDP.

schemes.label: TCP · connect out
schemes.hint: The device opens a TCP connection out to this server.
